name: Oil (Brent)
summary: Brent near $99 on 6 Nov, set for a 12% weekly fall; Alert holds on the Hormuz supply outage
state: Brent traded near $98.6 on 6 Nov, down 6% in a month and inside the Watch price band (Yahoo Finance), and is on course for a weekly fall of about 12% after the US midterms (Grafa). Alert is kept on the physical outage: Hormuz traffic was below 60% of typical levels and at least five vessel incidents were reported in the Gulf from 1 to 5 Nov (Voice of Emirates; Grafa).
for_you: Fuel, heating and transport costs remain exposed to Gulf supply disruption; prices have swung sharply day to day this week.
rubric_hit: Major physical supply outage (Hormuz traffic <60% of normal) = Alert; price $98.6 alone = Watch
basis_detail: raised above the data floor on reported events

sources.title: Voice of Emirates — Oil prices rise: Brent nears $100, while U.S. crude hits $91.66
Grafa — Oil prices face 12% weekly drop as Gulf risks persist

why: Oil feeds inflation, transport and household budgets; price spikes have preceded most post-war recessions.
drivers: OPEC+ output, Middle East supply risk, sanctions, demand, inventories, shipping disruption.

rubric.alert: Brent > $110, or 1-month change > +30%, or a major physical supply outage (> 2 mb/d).
